公司簡介
Company Profile

康師傅控股有限公司（「本公司」）及其附屬                     Tingyi (Cayman Islands) Holding Corp. (the “Company”), and its
公司（「本集團」）主要在中國從事生產和銷                     subsidiaries (the “Group”) specialise in the production and distribution
售 方 便 麵 及 飲 品。 本 集 團 於 1992 年 開 始        of instant noodles and beverages in the People’s Republic of China (the
生 產 方 便 麵， 並 自 1996 年 起 擴 大 業 務 至        “PRC”). The Group started its instant noodle business in 1992, and
方便食品及飲品；2012 年 3 月，本集團進                  expanded into instant food business and beverage business in 1996.
一步拓展飲料業務範圍，完成與 PepsiCo                   In March 2012, the Group further expanded its beverage business by
中國飲料業務之戰略聯盟，開始獨家負責                       forming a strategic alliance with PepsiCo for the beverage business in
製 造、 灌 裝、 包 裝、 銷 售 及 分 銷 PepsiCo         the PRC. The Company exclusively manufactures, bottles, packages,
於 中 國 的 非 酒 精 飲 料。「康 師 傅 」作 為 中          distributes and sells PepsiCo soft drinks in the PRC. After years of hard
國家喻戶曉的品牌，經過多年的耕耘與積                       work and accumulation, “Master Kong” has become one of the best-
累，深受中國消費者喜愛和支持。                          known brands among consumers in the PRC.

康師傅作為快消品行業的領導品牌，肩負                       Being a leading brand in the fast moving consumer goods industry,
引領行業食品安全與質量保障的使命，本                       Master Kong has to hold the industry responsibility of food safety
集團不斷構建和完善管理體系，建立風險                       and quality guarantee. The Group constantly builds and improves
預防管理機制，實施食品安全的全方位控                       management system, establishes risk prevention management system,
制，確保產品質量與安全，為廣大消費者                       implements entire control over food safety and ensures product quality
提供安全、美味、健康的食品。                           and safety. We will constantly strive for product quality and food safety,
                                         as well as provide consumers with safe, tasty and healthy food products.

本集團不斷完善遍佈全國各地的銷售網                        The Group distributed its products throughout the PRC through
絡， 令 新 產 品 更 加 快 速、 有 效 地 登 陸 市          its extensive sales network consisting of 355 sales offices and 262
場，使得集團產品處於行業領先地位。截                       warehouses serving 57,609 wholesalers and 287,037 direct retailers
至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本集團共擁有 355            as of 31 December 2025. This extensive sales network is a significant
個營業部及 262 個倉庫以服務 57,609 家經               contributor to the Group’s leading market position and it enables the
銷商及 287,037 家直營零售商。                      Group to introduce new products rapidly and effectively.

本公司於 1996 年 2 月在香港聯合交易所有                 The Company was listed on The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited
限公司上市。於 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公              in February 1996. Market capitalisation as at 31 December 2025 was
司之市值達 665 億港幣。現時本公司為摩                    HK$66.5 billion. The Company is a constituent stock of Morgan Stanley
根士丹利資本國際 (MSCI) 中國指數成份股                  Capital International (MSCI) China Index and Hang Seng Index.
及恒生指數成份股。

今後，本集團仍將發展焦點集中於食品製                       Focused on food manufacture, sales and distribution business, the
造、行銷及流通行業，並繼續強化通路與                       Group will continue to strengthen its logistics and sales network in the
銷售系統網絡，以建立「全球最大中式方                       PRC with target of becoming “The largest Group for Chinese Instant
便食品及飲品集團」為奮鬥目標。                          Food & Beverage in the World”.

Chairman’s Statement

康師傅控股作為中國食品飲料行業領先的                 Master Kong, as a leading national brand in China’s food and
民族品牌企業，始終堅守「歡樂飲食，美                 beverage industry, has consistently upheld the corporate mission of
好 生 活 」的 企 業 使 命。 自 1992 年 品 牌 創   “Life+Delicacy”. Since the creation of the brand in 1992, we have
立，我們始終以消費者需求為導向，在風                 always been oriented toward consumer demands, forging ahead
雲變幻的市場浪潮中創新奮進，致力於推                 with innovations in the dynamic market landscape, and committed to
動企業實現穩健而深遠的「高質量發展」。                driving the enterprise to achieve robust and profound “high-quality
                                   development”.
2026 年 2 月是康師傅在香港聯合交易所上            February 2026 marks the 30th anniversary of Master Kong’s listing on
市三十周年的日子。三十年來，我們從一                 the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. Over the past 30 years, we started from
碗方便麵起步，成長為覆蓋億萬家庭日常                 a bowl of instant noodles and have grown into a comprehensive food
消費的綜合食品飲料企業。這一路，離不                 and beverage enterprise, covering the daily consumption of hundreds
開每一位消費者的選擇、每一位合作夥伴                 of millions of families. This journey is inseparable from the choices of

出。在此，我謹代表董事會，向大家致以                 dedication of generations of Master Kong’s employees. On behalf of the
最誠摯的謝意。                            Board of Directors, I would like to express my utmost gratitude to each

宏觀及行業回顧                                MACRO AND INDUSTRY REVIEW

2025 年，中國經濟在 GDP 同比 5% 的增長             In 2025, China’s economy showed resilience with a 5% year-on-year
中展現韌性。但食品飲料市場進入存量博                     GDP growth. However, the food and beverages market entered into
弈，以及對功能價值與情緒價值需求升級                     the stage of stock competition and demand upgrading for functional
階段。品牌、品質與風味仍是購買決策的                     and emotional values. Brand, quality and flavors remained key drivers
重要驅動因素。此外，即時零售、零食折                     of purchasing decisions. In addition, emerging formats such as instant
扣店、會員店等新興業態帶來渠道與消費                     retail, snack discount stores, and membership stores had brought
行為劇烈變革。在此背景下，企業需要構                     about drastic changes in channels and consumption behaviors. In this
建核心品牌的規模護城河，更需不斷在產                     context, companies need to build scale as competitive moat for their
品和渠道上創新，才能實現可持續發展。                     core brands, and continuously drive product and channel innovations to
                                       achieve sustainable development.

心，統籌推進方便麵與飲品業務高質量發                     consumer-centric approach and advance the high-quality development
展。方便麵業務聚焦「鞏固大單品、佔領                     of the Instant Noodles and Beverages Business in a coordinated way.
大口味賽道、培育創新產品」戰略，飲品                     The Instant Noodles Business focused on the strategy of “consolidating
業務堅定實施「鞏固核心單品、發展創新                     blockbuster products, seizing the popular flavors track, and cultivating
產品」戰略，豐富產品佈局，積極滿足多                     innovative products”, and the Beverages Business firmly executed the
元場景需求。同時，加速佈局即時零售等                     strategy of “consolidating core products and developing innovative
高增長渠道，充分發揮數字化工具在場景                     products”, thus enriching product portfolio, and effectively meeting
營銷、供應鏈提效、溝通決策等方面的重                     the demands of diverse scenarios. At the same time, efforts were made
要作用，全面提升整體運營效率。                        to accelerate the layout of high-growth channels such as instant retail,

案例：方便面事業引入煮醬機器人
Case: Introduction of Sauce Cooking Robots in the Instant Noodles Business

醬包是產品品質及風味的關鍵要素之一。方便面事業為醬包製作建立了嚴格的工藝標準體系，並在核心的「煮醬」環
節引入智能煮醬機器人，依託自動化裝備與製造執行系統（Manufacturing Execution System，MES）的深度協同與無
縫集成，將傳統烹飪技藝轉化為數字化標準，實現了煮醬工藝的全流程自動化，在保障地道風味的同時，大幅提升
了生產效率與產品品質的穩定性。


Sauce packets are one of the core elements that define product quality and flavor. Master Kong’s Instant Noodles
Business has established a rigorous process standard system for sauce packet production and introduced intelligent
sauce cooking robots in the core “sauce cooking” process. Leveraging the in-depth synergy and seamless integration
between automated equipment and the Manufacturing Execution System (MES), we have translated traditional culinary
craftsmanship into digital standards, and achieved full-process automation of the sauce cooking workflow. While
preserving the authentic flavor of the products, this initiative has significantly boosted production efficiency and the
consistency of product quality.

                                    Sauce cooking robot of instant noodles business

          財務影響。基於現有評估，預                       on our current assessment, these factors are not expected to
          計在下一報告期內，這些因素                       result in material adjustments to the carrying value of assets
          不會對資產及負債的賬面價值                       and liabilities in the next reporting period. We will continue
          產生重大調整。我們將持續監                       to monitor relevant risk profile and carefully evaluate
          測相關風險狀況，並審慎評估                       their potential impact on the Group’s long-term financial

          影響。

          風險管理                                Risk Management

本公司致力通過可持續的股息政策，在符                  The Company seeks to maintain a balance between meeting
合股東期望與審慎資本管理兩者之間保持                  shareholders’ expectations and prudent capital management with
平衡。本公司的股息政策旨在讓股東得以                  a sustainable dividend policy. The Company’s dividend policy aims
分享本公司的利潤，同時讓本公司預留足                  to allow shareholders to participate in the Company’s profit and for
夠儲備金供日後發展之用。在建議宣佈及                  the Company to retain adequate reserves for future development.
派付股息時，本公司會考慮多項因素：包                  In proposing any dividend payout, the Company would consider
括本集團的實際和預期財務業績、本集團                  various factors including the Group’s actual and expected financial
的流動資金水準及未來發展計劃、整體經                  performance, the Group’s liquidity levels and future development plans,
濟及金融狀況、本集團的商業週期、可能                  general economic and financial conditions, business cycle of the Group,

           在其他全面收益賬處理的權益                               financial instruments, which are measured at fair value as

           於下列之會計政策。


     (b)   綜合基準                                  (b)   Basis of consolidation

           綜合財務報表包括本公司及各                               The consolidated financial statements comprise the financial

           個月 ECL 代表預期由金融工具                            lifetime ECL that is expected to result from default events

           ECL 其 中 部 分， 該 部 分 在 報 告                    after the reporting date.

           多個共享信貸風險特徵分組：                               shared credit risk characteristics:

           並確認他們曾對本集團作出的                                   (as defined below) had or may have made to the Group. The
           貢 獻。 該 2008 年 購 股 權 計 劃                         2008 Share Option Scheme expired on 19 March 2018 and
           於 2018 年 3 月 19 日 到 期 及 剩                       the outstanding share options are exercisable until the end
